title: Activepieces License Cost: Pricing by Plan (2026)
summary: Activepieces license cost varies by plan from free to $200 monthly, but your actual bill depends on overage charges beyond usage limits.
body_markdown:
## Identify hidden costs and limits per plan


Five costs sit outside the headline price:


- credit overage
- AI step multipliers
- the Team user cap
- SSO gating
- self-hosting overhead


### Credit overage and user caps


Each extra credit past your plan's allowance costs $0.007. A month that needs 10,000 credits more than Plus includes adds $70. That's three and a half times the $20 plan fee.


Once AI steps are in the workflow, credits drain faster than on ordinary steps. A Fast step costs 2 credits, a Smart step 10 and a Frontier step 20.


A workflow that makes 1,000 Frontier calls a month uses 20,000 credits, double Plus's 10,000, so pick the model tier before you pick the plan.


When a department outgrows Team's 25 users, it goes to a sales quote. SSO is included on Team. SSO beyond Team is quoted by sales. Anyone whose security review requires SSO should settle that before choosing a tier.


### Self-hosting: the cost outside the license


In a self-hosted budget, server rental is the smallest line, and the chart shows how small.[Hostinger](https://www.hostinger.com/applications/activepieces) lists three VPS sizes:


- $6.49 a month
- $8.79 a month
- $12.99 a month


Those intro prices cover only the machine. Upgrades, backups, monitoring and the person who gets paged when a workflow stalls aren't in them, and staff time will outweigh the VPS bill within a month or two.


If you want a paid self-hosted enterprise license, sales quotes it, and the quote depends on users, credits, deployment and support. SOC 2 is in progress, not certified, so don't promise an auditor a report that doesn't exist yet.


### When Community Edition is enough, and when it isn't


When one technical team runs its own automations, needs no SSO, and can own upgrades and uptime, the free Community Edition is enough.


Need SSO, vendor support or compliance paperwork, and the Community Edition stops being enough.

It also stops when you want to embed automation in your own product, which starts at $36k a year on Embed. If any of those apply, skip the VPS maths.
